content: {"summary":"Customers report that recent iOS updates cause frequent device freezes and battery drain, leading to frustration and potential brand switching. Many users note that new phones arrive with subtle faults that require time-consuming troubleshooting, eroding trust in quality control. The Find My iPhone feature is cited as unreliable, with users unable to locate devices even after setup. Overall, the negative sentiment is high, with users threatening to abandon the ecosystem due to perceived incompetence and lack of support."}
